$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of a THEORY in construction (theory-shaped collection, TAXONOMY_SCHEMA.md 2026-10-16). Load first; follow detail pointers. Problems here are probes at a seam, not ends.
$meta.what_is_it: Which finitely additive two-valued states (states) on Dynkin carriers glued from window events are points, ideal points (ultrafilters on Omega), or pointless - and which shape of window graph decides it.
$meta.the_shape: Cycle x infinity is the seam. Cycle-only theory is owned (Vorob'ev/BFMY, sheaf contextuality, Kharoof-Ipek-Okay 2024 for cycle-scenario vertices). Infinity-only theory is owned (de Finetti, Howson 2008). No theory found treats finitely additive states on glued non-Boolean carriers. Data points so far: paths never pointless (hand); rings L>=4 pointless and sigma-forbidden (Lean); triangle open (sub-carrier evidence leans 'any cycle'). UPDATE 2026-10-16: triangle-free => locality (stars); forests => no pointless states; any induced cycle of length >= 4 => pointless states (transport). Open = chordal non-forest graphs, decided by the triangle. UPDATE 2026-10-17: TRIANGLE PROBE FIRED (a) - the triangle carries a pointless state (Lean, thm.triangle_pointless); with loops-travel + forests (hand): pointless <=> not a forest. Scope: pair windows over N (countably infinite alphabet). Over a finite alphabet every state is a point; a window covering the whole triangle makes the carrier Boolean.

objects.name: glued carrier
objects.one_line: Possibility space Omega = X^V (assumed: what could be the case) with a family of two-element windows; window event = {x:(x_i,x_j) in A}, A arbitrary; carrier D = Dynkin closure of all window events.

objects.name: state (finitely additive two-valued)
objects.one_line: s: D -> {0,1}, s(Omega)=1, additive on disjoint pairs. Restricted to one window it is an ultrafilter u_k on X^2; adjacent u_k share marginals.

objects.name: point / ideal point / pointless
objects.one_line: A state is a point (delta_omega), an ideal point (s(E)=[E in W] for an ultrafilter W on Omega), or pointless (neither).

objects.name: ordered product p(x)p
objects.one_line: A in p(x)q iff {m:{n:(m,n) in A} in q} in p - 'draw m, then n later'. With p non-principal: {m<n} in p(x)p, marginals p, not symmetric.

objects.name: window graph
objects.one_line: Vertices = coordinates, edges = windows. Path, ring (L), triangle (L=3) are the instances studied; the theory's invariant should be a property of this graph.

objects.name: window family; flat / twisted (tentative)
objects.one_line: A state's window family = its ultrafilters u_k on the windows (compatible on shared coordinates). Flat = amalgamates to an ultrafilter on Omega; twisted (non-flat) otherwise. Working definition, the candidate central notion.

theorems.one_line: Let B_n = {min pairwise gap <= n} and F = {Z: Z delta E* or Z delta E*^c lies in some B_n}. No member of F is in the Dynkin closure D over N; in particular E* is not in D. Lift lemma: if Z delta E* is in B_n and f has zero box interaction with f = 0 off Z, then f is constant on strict-cyclic points with gaps >= 2n+2 (box lifting the minimum far above the maximum; the other six corners are generic anticyclic). Least-stage argument: a complement stays in F; in a countable disjoint union exactly one piece takes the generic part and is an earlier member of F.
